items.upstream_edge_claim: SNX14 Loss of Function contributes to Impaired Autophagosome Clearance in Neural Progenitors.
items.atomic_claim: SNX14 loss slows autophagic LC3 flux in patient-derived neural progenitor cells.

evidence.experimental_system: patient-derived neural progenitor cells, nutrient deprivation, leupeptin and ammonium chloride flux block
evidence.span: By LC3 flux analysis in nutrient deprived conditions, where LC3II ratios in the presence and absence of lysosomal inhibitors (Leupeptin and NH 4 Cl) were calculated 20 , we identified slower LC3 flux in patient cells compared to controls.
evidence.extraction_note: Genuine flux measurement with lysosomal inhibitors, not inferred from steady-state LC3-II. This is the strongest support for the edge and it is specific to neural progenitors.

evidence.experimental_system: patient cells with genetic complementation by tagged SNX14
evidence.span: Importantly, the increased LC3 II levels were recovered to basal rates by forced expression of tagged SNX14 into patient cells ( Fig. 4a ).
evidence.extraction_note: Genetic complementation: re-expression of SNX14 normalised elevated LC3-II, establishing SNX14 dependence of the readout. Same publication as s01, so not an independent source.

items.upstream_edge_claim: SNX14 Loss of Function contributes to Impaired Autophagosome Clearance in Neural Progenitors.

evidence.experimental_system: SCAR20 patient fibroblasts, marker colocalisation and p62 degradation
evidence.span: we observe a very strong colocalization of autophagosome and lysosome associated markers indicating the efficient formation of autolysosomes in SCAR20 mutant fibroblasts
evidence.extraction_note: Preserved autolysosome formation in patient fibroblasts under the tested conditions. Patient cells, but a non-neural cell type. Full text is not open access.

items.upstream_edge_claim: Biallelic STUB1 Loss-of-Function Variants contributes to Loss of CHIP E3 Ubiquitin Ligase Activity.
items.atomic_claim: SCAR16 U-box missense alleles other than p.Thr246Met cause loss of CHIP E3 ubiquitin ligase activity.

evidence.experimental_system: purified recombinant CHIP, in vitro ubiquitination, 37 C, 1 h
evidence.span: The ubiquitination activities of the other mutants (E28K, K145Q, M211I, and S236T) were not overtly different from WT CHIP.
evidence.extraction_note: Four of six tested disease alleles retain bulk ligase activity in this assay. This is the upstream REFUTE pointer already curated on the SCAR16 node.

evidence.experimental_system: recombinant CHIP assayed below the mutants' melting temperature
evidence.span: Consistent with decreased CHIP stability promoting its dysfunction in SCAR16, most mutant proteins recovered activity when the assays were performed below the mutants' melting temperature.
evidence.extraction_note: Temperature dependence: the same alleles score as defective or near-normal depending on assay temperature. Panel alleles are not enumerated in this sentence, so this is class-level.

evidence.experimental_system: recombinant CHIP panel across SCAR16 alleles
evidence.span: Second, all mutant CHIP proteins maintained some capacity to polyubiquitinate HSP70 except for two Ubox mutants, M240T and T246M ( Fig. 3 E ).
evidence.extraction_note: Same sentence establishes the complement: every other tested SCAR16 allele retained some HSP70 polyubiquitination. Recorded separately as o12.

evidence.experimental_system: recombinant protein biochemistry and cellular models, 13 variants
evidence.span: Conversely, U-box variants abolished ligase function, promoted the formation of high-molecular-weight oligomers, and often increased CHIP levels while only partially impairing co-chaperone activity.
evidence.extraction_note: Cross-entity (SCA48). Also reports temperature-sensitive defects across mutants.

items.upstream_edge_claim: SNX14 Loss of Function contributes to Impaired Autophagosome Clearance in Neural Progenitors.

evidence.experimental_system: HEK293 SNX14 knockout, tandem fluorescent LC3 reporter
evidence.span: indicating that loss of SNX14 did not impact autophagosome-lysosome fusion
evidence.extraction_note: Refutes a general fusion block. Measured in HEK293, a non-neural line, so it constrains the fusion sub-step rather than the neural-progenitor clearance finding. Full text is not open access, so the results-section span cannot be located.

evidence.experimental_system: HEK293T transient overexpression with immunoprecipitation
evidence.span: The results demonstrated that this truncation mutant exhibited significantly reduced ubiquitination activity toward Hsc70, with markedly decreased Hsc70 polyubiquitination compared to that of wild-type STUB1 (Fig. 3 C-E).

evidence.experimental_system: purified recombinant CHIP, in vitro ubiquitination, 37 C, 1 h
evidence.span: Hsc70 seemed to be mono-ubiquitinated by the N65S mutant, while no Hsc70-ubiquitination was detected for T246M, confirming previous findings on these two variants [ 3 , 9 ].
evidence.extraction_note: Hsc70 chain elongation is reduced to mono-ubiquitination while CHIP self-ubiquitination is retained. This is a processivity/readout-specific defect; the experiment does not compare multiple substrates and therefore does not establish substrate selectivity.

evidence.extraction_note: Independent replication of impaired HSC70 ubiquitination with retained self-ubiquitination. These are distinct readouts; without a multi-substrate comparison this is coded as a processivity/readout-specific defect, not substrate selectivity.
